title.en: What Is a Black Hole, Really?

desc.zh: 把一团质量压进 2GM/c² 以内会怎样？九个可以拖动的模型：逃逸速度追上光速、黑洞不会“吸”（除非你进到 3 r_s 以内）、相对论轨道、潮汐撕裂、时间变慢、比视界大的影子，以及恒星轨道和引力波这些证据。
desc.en: What happens when a mass is squeezed inside 2GM/c²? Nine models you can push: escape speed reaching light speed, why black holes don't suck (until you are within 3 r_s), relativistic orbits, tidal stretching, slowed clocks, a shadow bigger than the horizon, and the evidence from stellar orbits and gravitational waves.

title.zh: 逃逸速度与史瓦西半径
title.en: Escape speed and the Schwarzschild radius

desc.zh: 质量压得越小逃逸速度越大，压到 rₛ = 2GM/c² 时等于光速；这是启发式算法，真正的视界来自广义相对论。
desc.en: Squeeze a mass and its escape speed rises until it reaches c at r_s = 2GM/c²; a heuristic that happens to match the horizon of general relativity.

en: why can't light escape a black hole
how small would Earth be as a black hole

desc.zh: 视界半径和质量成正比，按体积平均的“密度”与质量平方成反比：超大质量黑洞可以比水还稀。
desc.en: Horizon radius grows in proportion to mass, so mass per volume falls as 1/M²: a supermassive black hole can be less dense than water.

en: how big is a black hole
black hole less dense than water

desc.zh: 同样的距离，黑洞的引力和同样重的恒星一样：把太阳换成同质量的黑洞，地球轨道不变。
desc.en: At the same distance a black hole pulls like any equal mass: replace the Sun with a one-solar-mass black hole and Earth's orbit does not change.

zh: 黑洞会把东西吸进去吗
en: do black holes suck things in
what if the Sun became a black hole

title.zh: 最内稳定圆轨道与光子球
title.en: Innermost stable orbit and the photon sphere

desc.zh: 离黑洞几个 rₛ 以内引力比牛顿说的强：轨道进动，3 rₛ 以内没有稳定圆轨道，1.5 rₛ 处光可以绕圈。
desc.en: Within a few r_s gravity is stronger than Newton's: orbits precess, no circular orbit is stable inside 3 r_s, and light can circle at 1.5 r_s.

desc.zh: 头脚之间的引力差在视界上与质量平方成反比：小黑洞在视界外就把人撕开，大黑洞可以平安穿过。
desc.en: The head-to-foot difference in pull at the horizon falls as 1/M²: small black holes tear you apart outside, large ones let you cross intact.

en: what happens if you fall into a black hole
torn apart by a black hole
can you survive crossing the event horizon

title.zh: 引力时间膨胀与引力红移

desc.zh: 悬停在 r 处的钟按 √(1 − rₛ/r) 变慢，越近视界越慢；GPS 卫星每天要为此修正几十微秒。
desc.en: A clock hovering at r ticks at √(1 − r_s/r), slower near the horizon; GPS satellites correct for tens of microseconds a day.

en: time slows near a black hole

desc.zh: 瞄准中心 2.6 rₛ 以内的光都被吞掉，所以看到的黑影约是视界的 2.6 倍；EHT 拍到的人马座 A* 与之一致。
desc.en: Light aimed within 2.6 r_s is captured, so the dark shadow is about 2.6 times the horizon; the EHT image of Sgr A* agrees.

title.zh: 恒星 S2 称出人马座 A*
title.en: Weighing Sgr A* with the star S2

desc.zh: S2 绕银河系中心一圈 16 年，开普勒第三定律给出约 426 万个太阳质量挤在约 120 个日地距离以内。
desc.en: S2 circles the Galactic Centre every 16 years; Kepler's third law puts about 4.26 million solar masses inside about 120 AU.

zh: 开普勒第三定律 称质量
en: how do we know black holes exist

title.en: Gravitational waves from merging black holes

desc.zh: 两个黑洞绕转时辐射引力波、越绕越快，频率上扫成“啁啾”；GW150914 是 36 和 29 个太阳质量的合并。
desc.en: Orbiting black holes radiate gravitational waves and spiral in, sweeping up in frequency as a chirp; GW150914 was a 36 + 29 solar-mass merger.

title.zh: 黑洞到底是什么：霍金辐射与本页的边界
title.en: What a black hole is: Hawking radiation and the limits

desc.zh: 总结：远看是质量，近看改变轨道、时间和光；霍金辐射对天体黑洞可以忽略，视界以内本页不做断言。
desc.en: Summary: from afar just a mass, up close it reshapes orbits, time and light; Hawking radiation is negligible for astrophysical holes, and nothing is claimed about the interior.

en: what is inside a black hole
